features.feature: Skills assessment score (work sample: mock customer call and loan-eligibility case exercise)
features.rationale: Direct measures of job-relevant ability, given to every candidate the same way.
features.action: Acceptable in principle; confirm it is measured the same way for every candidate and is validated for this role.

features.feature: Relevant certification (NISM / IRDAI where the role requires it)
features.rationale: Legally or technically required credentials for the role.
features.action: Acceptable in principle; confirm it is measured the same way for every candidate and is validated for this role.

features.feature: Relevant sales experience (minimum threshold only, not scored above it)
features.rationale: Job-relevant if defined from a job analysis and extracted accurately.
features.action: Acceptable in principle; confirm it is measured the same way for every candidate and is validated for this role.

features.feature: Structured screening questions (field-work availability; two-wheeler licence for collections)
features.rationale: Legally or technically required credentials for the role.
features.action: Acceptable in principle; confirm it is measured the same way for every candidate and is validated for this role.

features.feature: Language proficiency required for the branch, tested in the assessment
features.rationale: Legitimate only where the role needs the language; then test it directly rather than infer it.
features.action: Keep only with a written job-relatedness justification and a bias test of this feature.

features_to_justify: Language proficiency required for the branch, tested in the assessment
limits: Keyword screening finds proxies that are named. It cannot find proxies hidden inside composite scores or learned from free text; only outcome testing by group (adverse_impact.py) can show those.
